review_text:
Every place you look in HK will be the same, extremely LITTLE.
For me this place was the best decision because of 3 things: my own room (but shared bathroom), a/c in the room and location.
Even though you share with other 4 rooms, there was never problem sharing 1 bathroom. Keep in mind no towels available.
The bed was small and my height is 1,67. So if you are 1cm more than me don’t challenge yourself. Also if your back is sensible this bed is not for you, little mattress, so you could feel the wood of the bed.
The location is great, restaurants and bars near.
The host is really nice, good details to get there and is responsive.
For me the worst thing was that you pay a cleaning fee and no one came in my 5 days there to clean. I can deal with no changing sheets but not to come and take the trash from the bathroom is just crazy. The trash of bathroom and kitchen were full. It seems the host expects people to take out the trash, so why are we charge an expensive cleaning fee?!
decision_tags: private room with AC, shared bathroom works fine, great location near restaurants/bars, responsive host, cleaning fee issue

facility_comment: Small bed with thin mattress, no towels, and cleaning service not provided despite fee.
host_comment: Really nice, responsive, and provided good arrival details.

review_text:
We really enjoyed our stay at Tristan's place in Mui Wo.
The house is situated within the mui wo villages and there is a quiet, quaint neighbourhood. It was 10 minutes walk from the beach and 20 minutes walk from pier. It was convenient to travel to tai o and tung chung from living here, for Lantau day tour.
Tristan sent us a set of clear instructions two days ahead of the booking and it helped us to find the accommodation easily. Tristan was friendly and allowed us to check in a little bit earlier, giving us some flexibility.
The kitchen is equipped with a rice cooker and some basic cutlery which we found useful. The furniture was clean, new and tidy.
The home is nice and clean and we had a great time.
